headline: Evening takes the chair.
body: The streetlamps come on one by one, as if arguing the point. A bus sighs at the corner and leaves its heat on the pavement. The desk lamp holds the page without asking.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: slate going ink, one last chimney

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet tarmac, tyre hiss, a closed florist

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: the hour that keeps its coat on
